ReleaseNotes: Improved the Dispatch Closeout Checklist for tickets with Multiple write-ups.
Each Write-up now has its own checklist, keeping previously complete items checked.
Checklists are organized oldest first, with tech names, submission dates, and individual progress tracking.
Added individual copy buttons beside equipment serial numbers.
Added Copy All SNs to copy serial numbers into a vertical stack for easier entry into SAP.
Copy All includes both removed and installed equipment SNs.
Improved ticket assignment tracking when techs are moved between crews.
Fixed issues where removed crew members could remain assigned to tickets.
Manually assigned techs now remain attached to tickets when crew assignments change.
Improved handling of tickets reassigned between multiple crews.
Improved Submit Write-Up Preview to show currently assigned techs, including those manually added by Dispatch.
Fixed an issue where (Unassigned) could incorrectly appear as a tech in the write-up preview.
Adjusted Field Tech History Search Bar debounce to 1500ms.
Fixed an issue where switching between Modules caused windows to jump back to the primary monitor.
Improved multi-monitor handling for different display arrangements and screen scaling.
